name: anim_jyu_slam_land
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: He lands heavily on both feet with a thud, keeping the leaned-back upright pose with the chest and big belly pushed forward, the body and belly jiggling, thick paint splashing around his feet, then he puts both hands on his hips. The face keeps the same thick angular eyebrows, half-lidded eyes and closed mouth. Heavy, sticky, viscous paint.
